# alpine-js-swiper

Alpine.js Swiper is a plugin that drives Swiper carousels through Alpine directives, expressions, magic properties, and reactive state.

Site: https://alpine-js-swiper.billynoyes.co.uk/
Docs: https://alpine-js-swiper.billynoyes.co.uk/docs/
Install: npm install alpine-js-swiper

Register with Alpine.plugin(AlpineSwiper) and import alpine-js-swiper/style.css before Alpine.start().
Use x-swiper for configuration, $swiper for methods and synchronized state, x-swiper-event: for Swiper events, and $store.swipers for named instances.
